episode_title: Beyond the AI Hype: Sam Shar on Making Technology Work for Your Business

real_qa.q: What does digital transformation mean for enterprise technology implementation?
real_qa.r: Digital transformation is taking initiatives that are historically paper-based and turning them into digital where it makes sense. Technology must improve actual business outcomes, whether through cost reduction, efficiency gains, or speed. Adoption and implementation matter just as much as the technology itself—you must provide proper training in phases to avoid business interruption, as people need to understand what is expected of them.

real_qa.q: Why is AI implementation failing in many businesses despite heavy investment?
real_qa.r: Many businesses implement AI just to have it or keep up with competitors rather than solving a specific problem. If you commit $30 million to AI without a clear use case and measurable ROI, shareholders will question what was actually gained. AI for the sake of AI is a mistake—it must be tied to concrete outcomes like improved efficiency, cost reduction, fewer errors, or reduced risk, not simply bragging rights.
real_qa.requete: why AI implementation fails businesses ROI

real_qa.q: How should leaders maintain client relationships during organizational transitions?
real_qa.r: Travel and in-person meetings are critical. Rather than relying only on phone calls and Zooms, getting in front of clients and employees shows involvement and builds trust. Visiting sites, sitting in meetings, and spending time after hours building relationships strengthens connections and demonstrates genuine commitment, which translates into client loyalty and referrals.
real_qa.requete: maintaining client relationships during leadership transition

real_qa.q: What are the real risks of AI tools like ChatGPT and Claude in business workflows?
real_qa.r: Both ChatGPT and Claude are wildly impressive but they do make errors—they can misinterpret things, work with false data, and produce incorrect outputs. You cannot fully rely on AI without double-checking and proofreading everything. If businesses think AI is fully automated and stop verifying work, there is significant room for errors that could harm operations.
real_qa.requete: ChatGPT Claude errors business risks accuracy

real_qa.q: How does Trendsetters Consulting advise clients on technology purchases without vendor bias?
real_qa.r: Trendsetters embeds deeply with clients to understand their real business needs and use cases. Unlike vendors who earn commissions, Trendsetters has no financial incentive tied to specific products—their only goal is client satisfaction. This allows them to recommend whether CRM A or B, cheaper or more expensive options, based purely on what actually fits the client's business, not sales incentives.

guest.bio_context: Sam Schar started his career in real estate, working in luxury real estate in Beverly Hills. His father founded Trendsetters Consulting over 30 years ago. After his father's death from cancer, Sam unexpectedly took over leadership of the company five years ago while simultaneously becoming a new parent. He transitioned from real estate to leading a technology consulting firm focused on digital transformation and business execution.
